sayTail.text: 📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 3 talent has been released into your sector.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
(Something new is moving in the treeline. It was never an animal.)
🔥 Declan, at the fire: "The treeline's different now. We mark it, we tell everyone, we don't go alone."
🔥 Mara, at the fire: "Then we meet it with torches and steel. I'm done being hunted."
"The audience is watching. The gamblers are watching. Everyone's watching. No pressure."
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📺 You step forward. "Me." The silence is total. The System tilts its head — it did not expect the price to walk up willingly.
📺 Oliver: sacrifice — Volunteer. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 The billing said EXTREME RISK. The System doesn't pull its punches.

📺 The debate is vicious and televised. Alliances form and break in real time.

Your name is on the short list. So are two others. The System is taking notes on who argues for whom — it finds loyalty fascinating and doomed.
📺 You make your case: your skills, your value, your future. It feels like begging. It is begging. The village listens.

📺 Dusk. The System calls for the name.

The village has voted. The envelope is opened. The cameras push in.
📺 Your name is called. You stand. You walk to the light with your head up. The village weeps. The System gets its season. You get... the prize. If you survive it.
A child drew you on the haven wall. You're very tall, and there are a lot of teeth on the other side.
📺 Oliver: sacrifice — Take it, if chosen. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 The highlight package is already cut. The Price will replay this forever — the club will remember.
📺 The Price — The damage was too much.
📺 You walked up willingly — or the village's vote did the walking. The System named its price and collected. The village will argue about that vote for a generation. It won't bring you back.
📺 The Death Reel will be tasteful. It won't be.
